note: Validation of this agent inference path (ONNX + normalization) against the published production V5 numbers, on the first 30,000 samples of the V5 val/test splits (features already normalized inside magicc_v5_features.h5). Reproduction confirms the R2 convention behind the published V5 numbers is the coefficient of determination (1 - SSres/SStot), not squared Pearson correlation.
